MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The long stainless wood screws fit my recent purchases of construction and outdoor deck screws because they could serve similar wood-fastening needs.",
    "The small pack feels reasonable for a specific job, although the Phillips drive is less appealing than the Torx drive I recently chose."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The short self-piercing screws share the name 'screws' with my recent purchases, but their length and intended use do not fit the same wood-fastening work.",
    "Epoxy, steel wool, cutting wheels and binder chain require repair, surface preparation, metal cutting or hauling needs that I have not shown.",
    "Vacuum bags were a specific replacement purchase; they do not mean I currently need enzyme cleaner or other general maintenance supplies."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been interpreted as interest in almost any workshop or home-maintenance supply.",
    "Broad similarities such as being a fastener or a cleaning product seem to matter more than whether the item serves my current task."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails and longer wood screws suggest that fastening purpose, dimensions and compatibility matter to me.",
    "Corrosion resistance fits my recent outdoor screw purchase, while drive type also affects whether a similar screw feels like a good replacement.",
    "I choose supplies when they address a concrete need; an isolated purchase of medicine cups or vacuum bags does not establish an ongoing interest in related supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical supplies, but most suggestions missed the specific wood-fastening needs behind my recent purchases."
}
